description: This PHP source file defines the RepairCommands class, a set of CLI commands for repairing and rebuilding parts of a SuiteCRM system, including database repair, extension rebuild, relationship rebuild, and record normalization.

classes.name: RepairCommands
classes.description: A class extending RoboTasks that provides CLI commands for repairing and rebuilding SuiteCRM components.

methods.name: repairDatabase
methods.description: Synchronizes database tables with vardefs, optionally executing SQL queries.

methods.name: repairRebuildExtensions
methods.description: Rebuilds CRM extension files found in custom/Extension.

methods.name: repairRebuildRelationships
methods.description: Rebuilds relationships defined in module vardefs.

methods.name: repairNormalizeRecordEncoding
methods.description: Repairs record normalization, either asynchronously via job queue or synchronously.
